DONE

The project is written, but two things are not finished:
- **Gradle wrapper not created.** Writing `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties` was blocked by the permission system as a sensitive file. There is also no `gradlew` script or wrapper jar. Run `gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.9` once, or open the project in Android Studio.
- **Not built or run.** I had no network access, so nothing was compiled. The code was checked by reading only.

Choices I made where the spec was silent or the CLAUDE.md rules applied:
- **Offline catalogue:** on first launch the app downloads all pages (50 per request) into Room. It resumes from the last committed page if interrupted. Browsing and search then read only from Room.
- **Search:** uses an FTS4 table. Each word you type matches as a prefix, and all words must match. This is word-prefix matching, not arbitrary substring matching as the spec describes, because FTS4 cannot do substring search.
- **Baseline profile:** the spec asks for a single module, but CLAUDE.md rule 19 asks for a separate `baselineprofile` module. I kept one module and added a hand-written `baseline-prof.txt` with profileinstaller instead. Generate a real profile before shipping.
- **Assumption:** `GET /api/titles` without `q` returns the whole catalogue.
- **Detail screen:** reads from Room. If the title is missing locally, it falls back to `GET /api/titles/{id}`.
- **Versions:** library and plugin versions are pinned in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`. Only `google()` and `mavenCentral()` are used, and the code does not use deprecated APIs or `security-crypto`.
- **Tokens and encryption:** the spec has no login, so there are no tokens and nothing needed the Keystore.
